subject.title: Track exact-review publication, lifecycle telemetry, and OpenClaw Bay correctness

question: After the Cloudflare migration stabilizes, should Completed mean every required lifecycle effect is complete, while GitHub delivery, canonical-state acceptance, and acknowledgement remain separately visible?
rationale: This definition controls the durable lifecycle contract and the meaning of completion across publication workers, Overview telemetry, and OpenClaw Bay; source inspection cannot safely substitute for the intended operational policy.

options.title: Require every effect
options.body: Define Completed only after all required delivery, canonical-state, acknowledgement, and required follow-up effects succeed, while exposing each intermediate fact separately.

options.title: Use canonical-state completion
options.body: Treat accepted canonical state as Completed and show acknowledgement or follow-up as separate post-completion work.

options.title: Keep workflow-derived completion
options.body: Continue deriving completion from workflow or job terminal states, accepting that it may not represent the durable item lifecycle.

recommendation.title: Require every effect
recommendation.body: Define Completed only after all required delivery, canonical-state, acknowledgement, and required follow-up effects succeed, while exposing each intermediate fact separately.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue explicitly assigns coordinated ownership here and the supplied merged history connects this contributor to the affected Bay and lifecycle telemetry surfaces.
